params.message:
Preview in the editor bar, and images from the sources in the text

From the sources. The + menu of the text offers From the sources next to Image: the same list
and the same usage-rights warning as the cover. A pick is copied into the
uploads by the pipeline (POST /articles/:id/images/from-source) and placed as a
body image with an empty caption; under it the editor shows which of the
piece's sources it came from. Needs the pipeline route; without it the copy is
refused and nothing is placed.

Preview. Saves what is on screen, asks the pipeline for a preview link
(POST /articles/:id/preview-link) and opens it in a new tab, which is opened on
the click so the browser does not block it. Posts only, once something is
written. Needs the pipeline route and the site's /preview/{token}.
